## Validation and limits

Two screened records were added to the development set: PMID 26923218, which evaluates methods and reporting practice in environmental-health systematic reviews, and PMID 32653802 (COSTER), which gives recommendations for their conduct. Both were retrieved, giving **100% development-set relative recall (2/2)**. There was no independent benchmark or held-out validation set, so this does not estimate sensitivity.

The optional methodological-rigour block was left out after testing: its broadened version reduced the count by 18.7%, below the skill’s approximate 30% material-reduction criterion. Its final 30-record loss sample had no clearly eligible record; one commentary had no abstract and remained uncertain.

The strategy passed the protected report gate. It is a draft for **human PRESS peer review by an information specialist before use**. The internal critic does not replace that review.
